summary_notes.purpose: Internal review aid for crop/tile extraction results; it does not change product JSON.
summary_notes.duplicate_candidate_groups: Dimensions that may be repeated because the same visible measurement was extracted from overlapping tiles.
summary_notes.strong_duplicate: A duplicate group with stronger matching evidence such as label or quantity; merge evidence only after review.
summary_notes.weak_duplicate: A duplicate group with limited matching evidence, usually missing label or quantity; review carefully.
summary_notes.full_page_supported_candidates: Tile dimensions that match a dimension found by full-page extraction.
summary_notes.tile_only_candidates: Tile dimensions not found in full-page extraction; they may be useful new evidence or crop-only false positives.
summary_notes.tile_only_review_candidates: Count of tile-only candidates that look potentially useful enough for manual review.
summary_notes.weak_tile_only: Tile-only candidates with weak evidence, such as missing labels or very short raw text.
summary_notes.non_product_candidate: Tile-only candidates that look like schematic ratios, reference labels, or other information that should not automatically become product dimensions.
